reasoning_evidence: The queue-reported COD 2028-01-01 does not match the signed CenterPoint SGIA: Exhibit B Schedule gives Scheduled COD = later of 2029-01-12 or 3 months after TIF In-Service (which is itself later of 2028-10-12 or 36 months after Prerequisite Items). The queue value is stale/misaligned with the executed contract (sources/2025-12-11_puct_35077-2322_centerpoint-emberyork-IA.pdf).

Physical feasibility for 2028-01-01: ruled out. GE 7HA turbines have ~24-36 month OEM lead time; the TEF response 2025-04-16 states turbines were still being negotiated (sources/2025-04-16_puct_56896-73_emberyork-response-to-denial.pdf); no public GE order announcement retrieved. From bare land at 2026-07-01, plant commissioning by 2028-01 is not physically achievable for a 900 MW simple-cycle site (multi-year build).

Financing overhang: Texas Energy Fund loan HARD-DENIED for due-diligence failure, PUCT Docket 56896 order 2025-04-15 explicitly 'not subject to motions for rehearing or appeal' (sources/2025-04-15_puct_56896-71_order-denying-loan-app.pdf). EYEC's stated substitute (First-round equity commitment from an unnamed A-credit-parent asset owner + Paul Hastings 'Term Sheet C') was a proposal at April 2025 and no closed-facility announcement located since (sources/2025-04-16_puct_56896-73_emberyork-response-to-denial.pdf).

Contractual pressure point: $99,157,000 letter of credit is due to CenterPoint by 2026-12-12 under SGIA Exhibit E (sources/2025-12-11_puct_35077-2322_centerpoint-emberyork-IA.pdf); ERCOT queue records financialSecurityAndNoticeToProceedProvided=No at the 2026-06-01 snapshot. Failure to post the LC enables IA termination under Section 2.1 — this is a near-term binary risk.

Sister EmberGreen project (same developer, same officer set, twin 900 MW) has told the Comptroller its own construction runs 2026-2029 with incentive period starting 2030 (sources/2026-04-15_comptroller_J0028_embergreen-wharton-jeti-recpkt.pdf Attachment A p.3) — EmberClear's own timeline confirms 2029, not 2028. EmberYork trails EmberGreen: EmberGreen has an approved JETI + earlier land activity; EmberYork has neither.

Positive counter-signals limiting the downside: TCEQ Standard Permit 1778571 stated received (sources/2025-04-16_puct_56896-73_emberyork-response-to-denial.pdf citing air permit issue 2024-12-17; application PDF at sources/2024-12_tceq_dID8484637_air-permit.pdf), fully executed 100-page SGIA on file, GE turbine models specified in IA — these establish the project as 'real early' not 'paper', but do not shorten the physical build timeline.

Independent COD estimate 2030-Q2: assumes turbine order placed late 2026/early 2027, NTP mid-2027, first fire late 2029/early 2030. 'high' drift risk from queue's 2028-01-01 reflects the ~2.5-year gap between reported and contractually plausible COD.
